name: B10-0170/2026 (Renew) – Human trafficking and grave human rights violations linked to the recruitment of non-Russian nationals, in particular from Africa, for Russia’s war of aggression in Ukraine
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on human trafficking and grave human rights violations linked to the recruitment of non-Russian nationals, in particular from Africa, for Russia’s war of aggression in Ukraine
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its position and making requests. It says Russia tricks foreign nationals, many from African countries, into fighting or working for its war in Ukraine, and calls this human trafficking and forced labour. It asks Russia to stop, asks governments to warn and protect their citizens, and asks the EU to help victims and prepare sanctions.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament asks for action but passes no law.
- **Who it affects:** African nationals targeted by recruiters, their families, and the governments involved.
- **What happens next:** The resolution goes to the Council, the Commission, the African Union, the UN, Ukraine and Russia.
